# Safe Carry 305

> Safe Carry 305 provides safety-first beginner pistol training in South Florida, taught by NRA certified instructor Carlos Guerra. Classes are built for true beginners, including people who have never handled a firearm. Instruction is offered in English and Spanish.

## About

- Instructor: Carlos Guerra, NRA certified firearms instructor
- Location: Homestead Training Center, 11700 SW 304th St, Homestead, FL 33033
- Group classes: 3 hours, maximum 5 students per class
- Private 1-on-1 classes: 2 hours
- The beginner class covers the training requirements for the Florida concealed weapons license (CWL)
- Firearm, ammunition, and eye and ear protection are provided; students do not need to own a firearm
- No firearms sales

## Classes

- [Class details and signup](https://safecarry305.com/class.html): Beginner Pistol Fundamentals. Pricing, the current class schedule, and signup are on this page only.
- Next group class: Saturday, December 5, 2026, 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM, Homestead Training Center

- Website: https://safecarry305.com/

## Policies

- Payment is due in full at signup
- Full refund when cancelling 48 hours or more before class start
- Students should avoid low-cut tops and loose-hanging clothing at the range
